1 X 39.0 MW | ps_units_manu_model = | th_cogeneration = | th_combined_cycle = | ps_electrical_capacity = 165 MW | ps_electrical_cap_fac = | website = | extra = }} '''BSES Kerala Power Limited''' is an independent power producer incorporated on 4 April 1996. It was established as a joint-venture by [[Reliance Infrastructure|Bombay Suburban Electricity Supply]] (BSES) and [[Kerala State Industrial Development Corporation|Kerala State Industrial Development Corporation Ltd]] (KSIDC).{{cite web|title=BSES Kerala Power Yet To See Light At End Of The Tunnel|url=http://www.financialexpress.com/archive/bses-kerala-power-yet-to-see-light-at-end-of-the-tunnel/65266/|accessdate=14 August 2016|publisher=Financial Express}} In December 2006, the Reliance Infrastructure bought stake in KSIDC and thus BSES Kerala Power became a wholly owned subsidiary of Reliance Infrastructure. The company is engaged in the activity of power generation. It operates one naphtha based Combined Cycle power plant at Udyogmandal, Kochi.{{cite web | url=http://www.kerala.me/industries/electricity/thermal-plants | title=Thermal Plants | accessdate=14 August 2016}} ==Overview== The plant’s nominal capacity is 165 MW in combined cycle mode of operation and the contracted capacity is net export of 157 MW at interconnection point. The Power Station consists of three GE make LM 6000 PC series, state-of-the-art aeroderivative Gas Turbines Generators (GTGs), suitable for dual-fuel operation. The GTGs and auxiliaries have been packaged, supplied and set up by Stewart & Stevenson, Houston, USA. Three dual pressure-45 tons/hour Heat Recovery Steam Generators (HRSGs) were supplied and set up by Thermax Babcok & Wilcox Limited. 39M W Steam Turbine Generators (STG) and auxiliaries have been supplied, set up and commissioned by Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL). The combined cycle power station started commercial operation on 23 November 2001.{{cite web | url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/specials/bses-kerala-power-to-reopen-ppa-raise-tariff-100110601031_1.html | title=Bses Kerala Power To Reopen Ppa, Raise Tariff | publisher=Business Standard | date=6 November 2000 | accessdate=14 August 2016}} ==Capacity== {| class="sortable wikitable" style="font-size:88%" ! Unit !! Installed Capacity ([[Watt#Megawatt|MW]]) !! Date of Commissioning !! Fuel !! Status !!Turbine Model/Type |- | 1 || 42.00 || 23-Nov-2001 ||naphtha/HSD||Operational||GE LM6000 PC NLW |- | 2 || 42.00 || 23-Nov-2001 ||naphtha/HSD||Operational||GE LM6000 PC NLW |- | 3 || 42.00 || 23-Nov-2001 ||naphtha/HSD||Operational||GE LM6000 PC NLW |- | 4 || 39.00 || 23-Nov-2001 ||Steam from Other Units||Operational||HNK 71/3.2- 4, BHEL make |} BSES Kerala Power has entered into a power purchase agreement with KSEB for the combined cycle operation.{{cite web | url=https://www.deccanchronicle.com/nation/current-affairs/130316/kerala-state-electricity-board-to-buy-power-from-reliance.html | title=Kerala State Electricity Board to buy power from Reliance | publisher=Deccan Chronicle | date=13 March 2016 | access-date=14 August 2016}} In fiscal year 2008, the power plant of BSES Kerala Power generated 373.989 MU of electricity at an average PLF of 25.12%. It has a fuel supply agreement with [[Indian Oil Corporation]] Limited for supplying naphtha. Under a PPA, the electricity generated by the company is also supplied to KSIDC.{{cite web | url=http://www.newindianexpress.com/states/kerala/Govt-may-reassess-power-purchase-deal-with-BKPL/2016/05/30/article3457237.ece | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160531103630/http://www.newindianexpress.com/states/kerala/Govt-may-reassess-power-purchase-deal-with-BKPL/2016/05/30/article3457237.ece | url-status=dead | archive-date=31 May 2016 | title=Govt may reassess power purchase deal with BKPL | publisher=New Indian Express | date=30 May 2016 | accessdate=14 August 2016}} It proposes to use liquified natural gas (LNG) from the Kochi terminal in future. ==See also== * [[Rajiv Gandhi Combined Cycle Power Plant]] * [[Brahmapuram Diesel Power Plant]] * [[List of power stations in India]] ==References== {{reflist|30em}} [[Category:Oil-fired power stations in Kerala]] [[Category:Power stations in Kochi]] [[Category:Energy infrastructure completed in 2001]] [[Category:2001 establishments in Kerala]]
